subject: Vendor security questionnaire and scope clarifications for FinOptics
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Porter <aporter@finoptics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Vendor security questionnaire and scope clarifications for FinOptics

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment.

TL;DR:
- Redwood is happy to complete the vendor security questionnaire; we can do SIG Lite/Full, CAIQ, or your custom spreadsheet. Let us know which you prefer for the initial pass.
- SOC 2: our SOC 2 Type II audit ran Apr 2026–Oct 2026; report is available and we can provide the attestation and a 1-pager.
- Data protection: we support EU data residency (GCP in europe) and have a HIPAA BA available for PHI scope — need confirmation whether FinOptics requires HIPAA applicability.

Questions for you so we can scope the work:
1) Which questionnaire format would you like us to prefill (SIG Lite, SIG Full, CAIQ spreadsheet, or your custom form)?
2) Do you need evidence attachments for each control, or is a representative sample sufficient to close initial assessment?
3) Will this cover processing of cardholder data / PHI (HIPAA)? If yes, please highlight the systems in scope or sample flows.
4) Target timeline for your security review / procurement decision (helpful so we can prioritize).

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm format and timeline.
- Redwood pre-fills CAIQ/SIG and uploads evidence to a secure share (we can prefill on a shared Drive link).
- Marissa (CC) will own collection of artifacts and follow up on any clarifying asks.

I attached a short SOC 2 summary and a suggested evidence checklist to speed things up.

Thanks — aiming to get you a prefill within 3 business days once format is confirmed.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf), redwood-evidence-checklist.xlsx (xls)

From: Alex Porter <aporter@finoptics.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Natalie Ruiz <natalie.ruiz@finoptics.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 11:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor security questionnaire and scope clarifications for FinOptics

Sean — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below and a couple of items from our side.

Answered:
- Questionnaire format: CAIQ spreadsheet first (we map CAIQ to our internal risk matrix). If we need deeper coverage we may request SIG Full after the CAIQ review.
- Evidence: for the initial pass we ask for representative evidence mapped to CAIQ control IDs; we typically request 3–5 artifacts per control family (e.g., policy, config screenshot, audit log extract).
- HIPAA / PHI: yes — we expect limited PHI in the scope (payment-related claims metadata). We'll send a short scope note by EOD.
- Timeline: target vendor decision by Feb 10; procurement needs vendor security signoff by Feb 3 to meet that.

I attached our CAIQ template (FinOptics_CAIC_template_v2.xlsx) and a short scope note (FinOptics_scope_2027-01-15.docx). We'll need the CAIQ prefill and evidence upload by Jan 26 to stay on schedule.

Two clarifying asks from our InfoSec team:
1) Does Redwood use customer-managed keys for data at rest (KMS/HSM)? If yes, which providers are supported?
2) For audit logs, can you provide retention windows and whether logs are forwarded to a customer-owned SIEM?

Appreciate it — I can extend the procurement timeline by a week if anything slips, but prefer to avoid that.

Thanks,
Alex Porter
Head of Security Programs
FinOptics
---
Attachments: FinOptics_CAIC_template_v2.xlsx (xls), FinOptics_scope_2027-01-15.docx (docx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Porter <aporter@finoptics.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 08:34:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor security questionnaire and scope clarifications for FinOptics

Alex — looping in Ben (CS lead) and confirming next steps from the Redwood side.

Thanks for confirming CAIQ. We can prefill the spreadsheet and upload representative evidence. Quick operational notes and asks so we don't miss anything:

Operational plan:
- By Jan 20 EOD: Redwood will upload a prefill of the CAIQ answers to the Drive link you provided and tag control IDs where we plan to supply evidence.
- By Jan 26: evidence bundle uploaded (PDFs/screenshots) into a secure share; final clarifications on any "respond via discussion" items.
- If FinOptics requires SIG Full later, we'll schedule a 60-min walkthrough.

Specific clarifications we need from you:
A) PHI scope: please confirm whether Full PHI payloads are in scope or only derived/metadata elements — this impacts the BA and encryption settings.
B) KMS: we support both customer-managed keys in GCP Cloud KMS and AWS KMS for Dedicated customers; hosted API uses Redwood-managed keys by default. If you need customer-managed keys for the integration, we'll need to know the preferred cloud provider and whether a cross-account IAM role will be used.
C) Audit logs: our standard retention is 90 days for application-level logs and 365 days for anonymized access logs; we can forward raw logs to a customer SIEM via a secure delivery pipeline for Dedicated deployments.

Ben will coordinate evidence collection from Product (KV cache config, network diagrams) and Security (SOC 2 artifacts).

If Jan 26 is tight, let us know and we can prioritize the PHI/KMS-related items first.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Marissa — thanks, that plan works. Quick confirmations: 

- PHI scope: limited PHI (payment metadata and limited PII). We'll attach a short scoping matrix to the Drive folder by tomorrow.
- KMS: FinOptics prefers customer-managed keys in AWS KMS for any encrypted backups. We will provide the principal/role details for cross-account access if Redwood needs it.
- Logs: we want raw access logs forwarded to our Splunk instance for 365-day retention; can you confirm S3 export or direct forward?

Action items for Redwood (requested timeline in-parens):
1) Pre-fill CAIQ and upload initial evidence mapping (Jan 20) — Alex
2) Confirm KMS cross-account role requirements and docs (Jan 21) — Redwood (Marissa/Ben)
3) Confirm log-forwarding method and sample configuration (Jan 22) — Redwood (Engineering)
4) Procurement signoff window (Feb 3) — FinOptics procurement

I will upload the CAIQ template backfilled with our internal mapping and the scoping matrix this evening. If you can point us to a secure upload link (Drive or Box) and a contact for evidence questions that will speed us up.

Thanks — looking forward to the prefill.

Best,
Alex Porter
Head of Security Programs
FinOptics
